In the northwest corner of the valley is a large mansion. The fancy house is owned by Romana, where she lives with her granddaughter [[Lumina (DS)|Lumina]] and her faithful employee [[Sebastian (DS)|Sebastian]]. Romana collects paintings, and some are from an artist named [[Jeff]] who lived in [[Mineral Town]] ages ago. She is trying to teach her granddaughter Lumina to be a proper lady, although Lumina has a strong mind of her own. She used to play piano when she was younger and teaches Lumina how to play the piano as well, as is the family's tradition. She spends most of her days in the mansion, but takes walks outside when the weather is nice.
